summary: Infosys Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, submitting the Revised Notice of its 45th Annual General Meeting (AGM) and the Integrated Annual Report for 2025-26. This is a routine administrative filing by a foreign private issuer to furnish its AGM notice and annual report to the SEC. There are no special-situation events such as mergers, tender offers, activist campaigns, or management changes involved. The filing serves only as a periodic disclosure requirement. No deal terms, stakeholder actions, or structural changes are present, making this a standard current report with no special-situation relevance.
